_comment: The overlay rules BOTH languages must enforce. The worker's validate_beat_sheet has always applied these; the platform's editor route did not, so an illegal overlay written by the chat agent reached beats.json and stopped the video at compile. Each case is asserted by worker/tests/test_validators.py and platform/test/overlayRules.test.ts against the same expectations, so the two cannot drift. `expect` is a substring that must appear in some violation; an empty list means the beats must be accepted.
script: The port fed the capital. Nearly 70% of all grain passed through it.

cases.name: a legal anchor overlay is accepted
a component that is not in the catalog
a component outside the channel's allowed list
a component that cannot attach to this anchor's type
an anchor_ref past the end of the beat's anchors
a fact-carrying component with no anchor_ref at all
a prop the component does not have
props_hint carrying a schema instead of a value
a no-anchor component on a pack with the emphasis class off (D86)
